note: Anthropic first-party API prices of Claude Opus 5.5 at standard speed and global routing: input $4, output $20, cache read $0.20 (0.05x). Cache writes cost 1.25x input ($5) with the 5-minute TTL and 2x input ($8) with the 1-hour TTL; the Claude cap books every cache write at the higher 2x price because a transcript does not say which TTL was used. Fast mode ($8 / $40) and US-only inference (1.1x) are never enabled by the driver and are not covered by this bound.
